meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让关键计划在敲定前先经受多方挑刺与交叉质疑,变得更扎实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你制定关键计划时希望有人从对立角度帮你查漏补缺,而不是只收获附和。
copy.tagline_en: Toughen up your plan by running it past a hostile review team before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own important plans and want them to survive hostile scrutiny before being locked in.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会成为一支 5 人对抗团队的 Lead:成员互相猛烈攻击彼此的发现,只保留挺过攻击的可用洞见,再交给专门的 planner 正式写成计划。
howto.when: 当某项规划需要最高严谨度,或你明确要求 hyperplan、对抗式规划、交叉批判式规划时接管;前提是 lead team 工具可用。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 对抗式评审这个上线方案
say.note: 会先启动 5 人互相批判的团队

say.text: 用 hyperplan 攻击这个方案的关键假设
say.note: 研究员角色会要求给出证据出处

say.text: hyperplan:先做交叉批判,再出正式计划
say.note: 批判结束后交给 planner 成文

howto.what_en: Claude becomes the Lead of a 5-member adversarial team: members ruthlessly attack each other's findings, only defensible insights survive, then a dedicated planner formalizes them into a plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when planning needs maximum rigor, or you ask for a hyperplan, adversarial, or cross-critique plan. Requires the lead team tools to be available.

say_en.text: Run a hyperplan adversarial review of this launch plan
say_en.note: Starts a 5-member team that critiques each other

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to attack the key assumptions in this plan
say_en.note: The researcher role demands evidence and citations

say_en.text: Hyperplan: cross-critique first, then a formal plan
say_en.note: A dedicated planner writes it after the critiques
